Introduction.SourceString: 异象管理局员工后勤报修次数最多记录保持者。
Introduction.LocalizedString: Holds the record for most maintenance requests submitted by BAC staff.

Content.SourceString:
有关异象管理局不可不知的冷知识其一：管理局休息室的沙发上，会固定长出一只安魂曲。
除此之外，被阳光照得暖呼呼的屋顶，安静而人迹罕至的楼梯间，亦或是一口看上去阴森森的、内衬却柔软又蓬松的棺材……也都是常见的安魂曲刷新点。
一天有二十四个小时，只用二十个小时来睡觉，不算多吧？

作为E.T.D四队最可爱的小王牌，安魂曲虽然不善交际，但人气一直居高不下。尽管投诉信数量与公物损毁率成正比，写给她的感谢信和粉丝信也同样多得惊人。
队内关系？自然也很和谐。即使在咔叽玛快食解决午餐时，因番茄酱被独占，大家只能用冰淇淋蘸薯条……都是小问题。

或许是因为过于天真纯粹，安魂曲拥有独特的「发现美的眼睛」。
具体表现为：不小心撞到路牌，磕得额头生疼；累得气喘吁吁才能走完的路程，乘上汽车就能很快抵达。这种时候，安魂曲会得出结论：路牌、汽车，很强大！安魂曲，也想学！
不过，自如地操纵异能，凭空捏造出这样那样的复杂形状，其实比人们想象中更为困难。在大家看不到的地方，安魂曲也付出过很多努力！——E.T.D预备队打着石膏的训练人员如此评价。

什么，安魂曲又不见了？——又迷路了吗？在哪里睡着了？还是被路边的番茄酱贩卖机吸引了？好吧，没关系，要相信她依旧是我们可靠的E.T.D队员。大家真的需要安魂曲时，她一定会赶来。
……虽然很可能会以沿途的玻璃门碎了一地为代价。
Content.LocalizedString:
Bureau of Anomaly Control Fun Fact #1: A Lacrimosa will regularly spawn on the break room couch.
Other common Lacrimosa spawn points include sun-warmed rooftops, quiet and rarely-visited stairwells, or the inside of a creepy-looking coffin that actually has soft, fluffy padding inside…
There are 24 hours in a day, so sleeping for only 20 hours isn't that much, right?

As ETD-4's adorable little ace, Lacrimosa may not be good at socializing, but her popularity remains sky-high. While her complaint letters are directly proportional to her property damage rate, the thank-you letters and fan mail she receives are equally staggering.
Team relationships? Harmonious. Even when having lunch at Clicky Fast Food, when all the ketchup gets hogged and everyone has to dip their french fries in ice cream instead… it's no big deal.

Perhaps because she's too innocent and pure, Lacrimosa has a unique "eye for discovering beauty."
This manifests as: accidentally bumping into street signs hard enough to hurt her forehead, or taking exhausting routes that take forever to walk despite being quickly reachable by car. In these moments, Lacrimosa reaches the conclusion: Street signs, cars, powerful! Lacrimosa, must learn!
"Actually, controlling Esper Abilities and creating all sorts of complex shapes out of thin air is actually much harder than people imagine. Lacrimosa has put in a lot of effort where no one can see!" —assessment from ETD reserve training staff currently in casts.

What, Lacrimosa's missing again? Did she get lost? Where did she fall asleep this time? Or was she distracted by a roadside tomato jelly vending machine? Well, no worries. Trust that she's still a reliable ETD team member. When the team really needs Lacrimosa, she'll definitely come running.
…Though it'll probably be at the cost of glass doors shattered all along the way.

Content.SourceString:
或许是异能的代价吧，除了番茄制品以外，安魂曲吃什么东西都没有味道。闻起来再香的食物，吃进嘴里，也像咀嚼柔软、筋道或酥脆的白开水一样。 
好处是：即使是薄荷「灵机一动」创造出的香蕉可可南瓜派，只要闻上去不算黑暗，安魂曲也能面无表情地吃得精光。  
据传，番茄制品品牌「番茄百分百」曾一度找到安魂曲，希望可以邀请她成为品牌代言人，但由于异象「番茄酱恶魔」造成的不良社会影响而暂时中断了合作计划。不过近期品牌方似乎有重启合作的意向……这里暂且按下不表。
Content.LocalizedString:
Perhaps it's the price of her Esper Abilities, but aside from tomato products, Lacrimosa can't taste anything she eats. No matter how delicious food smells, eating it is like chewing soft, chewy, or crispy plain cardboard.
The upside is that even when Mint has a "brilliant idea" and creates something like banana coco pumpkin pie, so long as it doesn't smell too questionable, Lacrimosa can eat it all with a straight face!
Rumor has it that the tomato product brand "Tomato 100" once approached Lacrimosa, hoping to invite her to become their spokesperson. However, the collaboration was temporarily suspended due to negative social impact caused by the "Tomato Devil" Anomaly. Recently though, the brand seems interested in restarting the partnership… but we'll leave that story for another time.

Content.SourceString:
海特洛实在太大，走路又实在太累。某天，安魂曲心想：要是可以不用走路就好了——下一秒，她便发现自己变成了小蝙蝠的形态，飞在了空中。嗯，很轻松。问题解决！
不过，现在安魂曲也有了新的烦恼。毕竟，不是每座建筑都有玻璃门，但玻璃窗可是随处可见。自从学会了飞行，安魂曲的额头和玻璃两败俱伤的情况就越来越常见。还有还有，飞行比起走路更省力，所以不由自主地闭上眼睛、打起瞌睡也很正常吧？可如果真的睡着了，难免会忘记扇动翅膀……砰！
Content.LocalizedString:
Hethereau is just too big, and walking is just too exhausting. One day, Lacrimosa thought to herself: "It'd be great if I didn't have to walk." The next second, she found herself transformed into a little bat, flying through the air. Mm, much easier. Problem solved!
However, now Lacrimosa had new troubles. After all, not every building had glass doors, but glass windows were everywhere. Ever since she learned to fly, situations where Lacrimosa's forehead and glass both get damaged have become increasingly common. To add to her woes, flying takes less effort than walking, so naturally closing her eyes and dozing off is pretty normal, right? If she actually falls asleep, however, she'll forget to flap her wings… and down comes a falling Lacrimosa from the sky.

Content.SourceString:
作为近几年最出名的邪道漫画「公爵K」的忠实粉丝，安魂曲自然常驻「呗果」，时刻关注最新情报。
打字太累了，安魂曲通常只窥屏、不说话，甚至因为懒得起网名实名上网。没想到，她还是因为频繁点赞而被同为「公爵K」狂热粉丝的「盖罗赛克特女子学院超异科王牌一号」抓到，半推半就地拥有了一个同好。
队友们对于安魂曲终于交到朋友甚感欣慰，但她至今还没能记住对方的全名，通常将其略称为「字很多网友」。不过另一方面，对方似乎也至今觉得她「用网名自称」的举止有些中二……
Content.LocalizedString:
As a devoted fan of the most famous cult manga "Duke K" in recent years, Lacrimosa naturally hangs out on Bagel, constantly keeping up with the latest news.
Typing is too hard, so Lacrimosa usually just lurks without commenting. She's even too lazy to come up with a username, so she goes online using her real name. Unexpectedly, she was caught by a fellow "Duke K" fanatic called "GeneSectParanormalDeptAce" because of her frequent likes, and somewhat reluctantly gained a friend with shared interests.
Her teammates are quite relieved that Lacrimosa has finally made a friend, but she still can't remember the other person's full username and usually just calls them "Net Friend With A Long Name." On the other hand, the other person apparently still thinks her habit of referring to herself in-person by her online username is rather self-centered…

Content.SourceString:
异象管理局的员工档案记录了安魂曲入队前的照片：坐在被夷为平地的便利店废墟上，专心致志地喝着番茄酱。
档案还显示，她几乎完全无法控制异能的情况，在进入E.T.D预备队学习了一段时间后，有了明显改善。从未来的队长那里收到的一对来源不明、有着明显使用痕迹的戒指，似乎为她的练习提供了很大帮助。
或许在她成长之后，能够觉察到这对戒指中蕴含的秘密……不过，那都是未来的事了。
Content.LocalizedString:
The Bureau of Anomaly Control's employee files contain a photo of Lacrimosa from before she joined the team: sitting on the ruins of a completely flattened convenience store, concentrating intently on drinking tomato jelly.
The files also show that her almost complete inability to control her Esper Abilities improved significantly after she spent some time training with the ETD reserve team. A pair of rings of unknown origin with obvious signs of use, received from a future captain, seemed to provide great help with her practice.
Perhaps after she grows up, she'll be able to sense the true secret contained within those rings… but that's all in the future.

Content.SourceString:
就像大多数人难以回想起自己的婴儿时期一样，安魂曲也想不起自己成为「安魂曲」之前的事情。
依据她苏醒时棺柩上刻着的一行文字，安魂曲决定了自己的名字。不如说，为什么其他人的名字都不是自己决定的呢？大人们不是一直告诉她，要自己选择成为怎样的人吗？
不过，像「小弥撒」或「安魂曲前辈」这样不由她决定的名字，似乎也是在叫她。那么，有了这些不同的名字，她会不会也会因此成为不同的人？……安魂曲还回答不了这么复杂的问题。
她只知道，队友们教过她，被叫到名字的时候要认真回应。安魂曲，有好好把这句话记在心里。
「那个E.T.D的怪力美少女，虽然总是面无表情，但是意外地没有大牌架子耶！上次在街上和她打招呼，她竟然回应我了！天呐，太可爱了！」
——像这样，在市民中的人气好像又上升了一些。
Content.LocalizedString:
Just like most people can't remember their earliest days as an infant, Lacrimosa can't recall anything from before she became "Lacrimosa."
Based on a line of text carved on the coffin where she woke up, Lacrimosa decided on her own name. Why don't other people get to decide their own? Don't adults always tell her that she should choose the kind of person she wants to become?
However, names she didn't choose like "Mosa" or "Lacrimosa Senpai" also seem to be calling her. If she had chosen a different name, would she have become a different person? …Lacrimosa can't answer such complex questions yet.
She only knows that her teammates taught her to respond seriously when her name is called. Lacrimosa has kept those words close to her heart.
"That super-strong pretty girl from ETD may always have a blank expression, but she's surprisingly down-to-earth! When I greeted her on the street last time, she even responded! Oh my gosh, so cute!"
Thus, her popularity among citizens rose a bit more.

Content.SourceString: ……你好。……唔。安魂曲，没有睡着，没有睡……
Content.LocalizedString: Hello… Mmhm… Ah. Lacrimosa, not asleep. Not asleep…

Content.SourceString: 呜呃！鞋带，踩到了……痛。……地上，凉凉的。安魂曲，不想起来……
Content.LocalizedString: Uwah…! Lacrimosa… stepped on shoelace… ow. Floor, cold… comfy.

Content.SourceString: 「失眠」，什么意思？唔……「睡不着觉」？不明白。安魂曲，闭上眼，就睡着了。……。……呼……
Content.LocalizedString: In-som-nia…? Insomnia? Hmm… "trouble sleeping"? Eh…? Sleep is easy… just close your eyes… zzz…

Content.SourceString: 「公爵K」很厉害……但是，也会弄坏东西，被大家训。和安魂曲一样。喜欢。
Content.LocalizedString: Duke K is strong… Duke K also breaks things and gets scolded by others… just like Lacrimosa.

Content.SourceString: 太阳，好刺眼……安魂曲，要闭眼了。
Content.LocalizedString: The sun… bright… Lacrimosa… going blind…
It's raining. Drip, drop… so sleepy…

Content.SourceString: 好冷……回到队里，又要被裹起来了。……嗯？就是……帽子、手套、围巾，毛茸茸……
Content.LocalizedString: So cold… Lacrimosa… going to get bundled up again… Hm? You know… hats, gloves, scarves… fuzzy and warm…

Content.SourceString: 冰淇淋，化掉了……安魂曲，也要化掉了……
鉴定师，早上好。安魂曲的早上，不好……又要工作了，好麻烦。
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, good morning. Lacrimosa, bad morning… Work, annoying.

Content.SourceString: 太阳，好像番茄。圆滚滚，橙色的……感觉很好吃。
Content.LocalizedString: The sun… looks like a tomato. Round. Bright. How would it taste…?

Content.SourceString: 天黑了，安魂曲要睡觉了。晚安，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: The sky is dark… Goodnight, appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 安魂曲，喜欢什么……唔，一个人在家，特别好。不工作，没有人吵安魂曲睡觉。安魂曲起床了，就可以吃番茄酱。还有，可以一直看《周刊Fantasy》，看到困……喜欢。嗯……安魂曲，现在可以回家了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: What do Lacrimosa like…? Hmm, being home alone is the best. No work, all sleep. When get up, Lacrimosa can eat tomato jelly, and read "Weekly Fantasy" until Lacrimosa get sleepy… Lacrimosa like that. Hmm… Can Lacrimosa go home now?

Content.SourceString: 白藏，麻烦精，又让翳不开心。法帝娅不帮忙，然后，越来越吵……安魂曲想要安静，就说：「对狗狗人，要有爱心」……白藏和法帝娅一起笑，更大声……安魂曲，不明白。
Content.LocalizedString: Baicang, troublemaker, Skia gets mad. Fadia, not helping, and then it gets noisier and noisier… Lacrimosa told them, "Be kind… to the doggo…" Baicang and Fadia laughed louder… Lacrimosa don't understand.

Content.SourceString: 安魂曲，不喜欢太阳。但是，太阳的味道……喜欢。「棉绒绒」，总是晒太阳，好闻。安魂曲，喜欢「棉绒绒」。和「棉绒绒」一起睡觉，很开心……
Content.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, avoid the sun. But Lacrimosa like how the sun smells… Fluffy always sunbathes and smells nice. Lacrimosa like Fluffy. Sleeping with Fluffy makes Lacrimosa happy…

Content.SourceString:
安魂曲，听说有「番茄钟」，想尝尝，问了狗狗人。狗狗人说，「番茄钟」不是吃的东西，是把工作时间，叫「一个番茄」「两个番茄」……
番茄不被吃掉，变成了工作的时间……番茄好可怜，人类，好坏……
Content.LocalizedString:
There is this… "tomato timer"… and Lacrimosa wanted a taste… Doggo said, the tomato timer is not for eating… it is for working, splitting time into tomatoes… "one tomato, two tomatoes…"
Tomatoes… not eaten, but for work… Poor tomato, bad human.

Content.SourceString: 工卡……又不见了……？……哦……脖子后面，找到了。大门，可以进了。谢谢你，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Where is… Lacrimosa's… ID card…? Oh… Behind… Flipped. Thank you, appraiser…

Content.SourceString: 异能，很方便。像这样……变成结实的东西，砸扁坏异象，就可以休息了。
Content.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa's Esper Ability… Like this… turn it into something solid, crush the bad anomaly flat, and then sleep…

Content.SourceString: 玻璃，看不到……总是撞到，好痛。然后，蜥蜴维修员说，为安魂曲「特殊定制」了……嗯……管理局的玻璃，不会碎了，安魂曲的头，要碎了……
Content.LocalizedString: Glass… Lacrimosa's enemy. Lacrimosa, always run into glass. Lizard guy said, um, replaced the glass, in the bureau. Glass, doesn't break. Lacrimosa, get hurt.

Content.SourceString: 番茄，最好了。安魂曲以后……要住在番茄城堡里，在番茄床上睡觉。其他食物，都消失吧，安魂曲，不需要……唔，冰淇淋要留下。
Content.LocalizedString: Tomatoes… Lacrimosa like tomatoes… One day, Lacrimosa will wake up from a tomato bed, and live life in a tomato castle. Other food, not needed… Maybe ice cream can stay.

Content.SourceString: 局长，冰冰的，蛇的眼睛。见到局长，就会有新工作。安魂曲，不开心……但狗狗人说，不可以惹局长生气。
Content.LocalizedString: Director, cold, snake eyes. Director comes, work comes. Lacrimosa, not happy… but doggo says, don't make director angry.

Content.SourceString: 法帝娅，不催安魂曲工作，喜欢……捏安魂曲的脸，不喜欢……
Content.LocalizedString: Fadia, never rushes Lacrimosa to work… good… Fadia, always pinch Lacrimosa on cheeks… bad…

Content.SourceString: 狗狗人，毛茸茸，很好摸……然后，个子很高，走得很快，追不上……但是，会蹲下来讲话，不用抬头。狗狗人，好。
Content.LocalizedString: Doggo… fluffy, nice to touch… tall, walks fast, can't keep up… but doggo crouches down when talking to Lacrimosa, so no need to look up… doggo, good.

Content.SourceString: 薄荷，亮亮的，很好认……还有，总是会抱上来，很热。
Content.LocalizedString: Mint… always shining, easy to see… always gives the biggest hugs… warm…

Content.SourceString: 「字很多网友」，也喜欢《公爵K》，一起追更，很开心。不过，没有见过面……以前，安魂曲去见「字很多网友」，但是，没见到。日期，记错了……
Content.LocalizedString: "Net Friend With A Long Name" likes "Duke K" too… following updates, together, fun. But.. never met in person… Lacrimosa went to see "Net Friend With A Long Name" once, but failed. Lacrimosa, went out on the wrong day…

Content.SourceString: 食堂，没有番茄酱，不好……但是，贩卖机有番茄酱。安魂曲，不会饿肚子。……嗯，还有，沙发可以睡觉。软软的，喜欢。但是，不可以被发现。
Content.LocalizedString: Cafeteria, out of tomato jelly, not good… but the vending machine has jelly. Lacrimosa won't go hungry… Oh, and the sofa is really comfy. It's soft… Lacrimosa can sleep on it. But can't get caught.

Content.SourceString: E.T.D，很忙。狗狗人，开会。白藏，捣乱。法帝娅，「交朋友」。安魂曲，睡觉……
Content.LocalizedString: ETD… busy. Doggo… meetings. Baicang… chaos. Fadia… "making friends". Lacrimosa… sleeping…

Content.SourceString: 安魂曲……超级超级喜欢。谢谢你，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa… love, love, love it. Thank you, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 哇……鉴定师，好厉害。送礼物的天才。
Content.LocalizedString: Wow… Appraiser, genius of, sending gifts.

Content.SourceString: 礼物，安魂曲会好好珍惜。

Content.LocalizedString: Let's all go home early today…

Content.SourceString: 捡到的东西……啊，要交给队里。
Content.LocalizedString: Found something… Ah, better give it to the team.

Content.SourceString: 安魂曲，捡到了亮闪闪的……
安魂曲，想休息一下。就一下……
Content.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, want to rest a bit. Just a bit…

Content.SourceString: 薄荷……好像很累，快去休息。
Content.LocalizedString: Mint… looks very tired, go rest now.
